verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֞ע שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בֶן־ מַתָּ֗ן וּגְדַלְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ פַּשְׁח֔וּר וְיוּכַל֙ בֶּן־ שֶׁ֣לֶמְיָ֔הוּ וּפַשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־ מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה אֶ֨ת־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ מְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ šə·p̄aṭ·yāh ḇen- mat·tān ū·ḡə·ḏal·yā·hū ben- paš·ḥūr wə·yū·ḵal ben- še·lem·yā·hū ū·p̄aš·ḥūr ben- mal·kî·yāh ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer yir·mə·yā·hū mə·ḏab·bêr ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now Shephatiah son of Mattan Gedaliah son of Pashhur Jucal son of Shelemiah and Pashhur son of Malchijah heard that Jeremiah had been telling . . . all the people
verses.literalPt: Ouviram Sefatias, filho de Matã, e Gedalias, filho de Pasur, e Jucal, filho de Selemias, e Pasur, filho de Malquias, as palavras que Jeremias falou a todo o povo, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּחֶ֖רֶב בָּרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וְהַיֹּצֵ֤א אֶל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּים֙ יִחְיֶה וְהָיְתָה־ לּ֥וֹ נַפְשׁ֛וֹ לְשָׁלָ֖ל וָחָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hay·yō·šêḇ bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ yā·mūṯ ba·ḥe·reḇ bā·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇad·dā·ḇer wə·hay·yō·ṣê ’el- hak·kaś·dîm yiḥ·yɛh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh- lōw nap̄·šōw lə·šā·lāl wā·ḥāy
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague but whoever surrenders to the Chaldeans will live he will retain his life like a spoil of war and he will live
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Quem ficar nesta cidade, morrerá à espada, de fome e de peste; mas quem sair aos caldeus, viverá; a sua vida lhe será por despojo e ele viverá.

verses.original: כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנָּתֹ֨ן תִּנָּתֵ֜ן הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֗את בְּיַ֛ד חֵ֥יל מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nā·ṯōn tin·nā·ṯên hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ bə·yaḏ ḥêl me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ū·lə·ḵā·ḏāh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says This city will surely be delivered . . . into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon and he will capture it
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Certamente esta cidade será entregue nas mãos do exército do rei de Babilônia, e ele a tomará.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ הַשָּׂרִ֜ים אֶל־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ י֣וּמַת נָא֮ אֶת־ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּה֒ כִּֽי־ עַל־ כֵּ֡ן הֽוּא־ מְרַפֵּ֡א אֶת־ יְדֵי֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַמִּלְחָמָ֜ה הַֽנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים׀ בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֗את וְאֵת֙ יְדֵ֣י כָל־ הָעָ֔ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֣י׀ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֗ה אֵינֶ֨נּוּ דֹרֵ֧שׁ לְשָׁל֛וֹם לָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כִּ֥י אִם־ לְרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū haś·śā·rîm ’el- ham·me·leḵ yū·maṯ nā ’eṯ- hā·’îš haz·zeh kî- ‘al- kên hū- mə·rap·pê ’eṯ- yə·ḏê ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh han·niš·’ā·rîm bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·’êṯ yə·ḏê ḵāl hā·‘ām lə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh kî hā·’îš haz·zeh ’ê·nen·nū ḏō·rêš lə·šā·lō·wm lā·‘ām haz·zeh kî ’im- lə·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: Then the officials said to the king This man ought to die . . . for . . . . . . he is discouraging - the warriors . . . who remain in this - city as well as all the people by speaking such words to them this man is not seeking the well-being of these people but . . . their ruin
verses.literalPt: Então disseram os príncipes ao rei: Tire-se a vida, rogamos-te, a esse homem; porquanto enfraquece as mãos dos homens de guerra que ficam nesta cidade, bem como as mãos de todo o povo, falando-lhes tais palavras; esse homem não busca o bem-estar deste povo, porém o mal.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ הִנֵּה־ ה֖וּא בְּיֶדְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אֵ֣ין הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יוּכַ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū hin·nêh- hū bə·yeḏ·ḵem kî- ’ên ham·me·leḵ yū·ḵal ’eṯ·ḵem dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Here he is replied King Zedekiah He is in your hands since the king can do nothing . . . to stop you
verses.literalPt: Respondeu o rei Zedequias: Eis que ele está nas vossas mãos; pois não é o rei quem possa fazer coisa alguma contra vós.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֣וּ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ וַיַּשְׁלִ֨כוּ אֹת֜וֹ אֶל־ הַבּ֣וֹר׀ מַלְכִּיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר֙ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֔ה וַיְשַׁלְּח֥וּ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בַּחֲבָלִ֑ים וּבַבּ֤וֹר אֵֽין־ מַ֙יִם֙ כִּ֣י אִם־ טִ֔יט וַיִּטְבַּ֥ע יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בַּטִּֽיט׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū way·yaš·li·ḵū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- hab·bō·wr mal·kî·yā·hū ḇen- ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh way·šal·lə·ḥū ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū ba·ḥă·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇab·bō·wr ’ên- ma·yim kî ’im- ṭîṭ way·yiṭ·ba‘ yir·mə·yā·hū baṭ·ṭîṭ
verses.literal: So they took Jeremiah and dropped him into the cistern of Malchiah the king’s son which was in the courtyard of the guard They lowered Jeremiah with ropes into the cistern which had no water but only . . . mud and Jeremiah sank down into the mud
verses.literalPt: Tomaram a Jeremias, e lançaram-no na masmorra de Malquias, filho do rei, a qual estava no pátio da guarda; e desceram Jeremias com cordas. Na masmorra não havia água, senão lodo; e Jeremias atolou-se no lodo.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֡ע עֶֽבֶד־ מֶ֨לֶךְ הַכּוּשִׁ֜י אִ֣ישׁ סָרִ֗יס וְהוּא֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי־ נָתְנ֥וּ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֶל־ הַבּ֑וֹר וְהַמֶּ֥לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּשַׁ֥עַר בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ‘e·ḇeḏ- me·leḵ hak·kū·šî ’îš sā·rîs wə·hū bə·ḇêṯ ham·me·leḵ kî- nā·ṯə·nū ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū ’el- hab·bō·wr wə·ham·me·leḵ yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ša·‘ar bin·yā·min
verses.literal: Now Ebed-melech the Cushite . . . a court official . . . in the royal . . . palace heard that Jeremiah had been put into the cistern While the king was sitting at the Gate of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Ora quando Ebede-Meleque o etíope, eunuco que estava na casa do rei, ouviu que tinham metido a Jeremias na masmorra (estando o rei naquele tempo sentado na porta de Benjamim);

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א עֶֽבֶד־ מֶ֖לֶךְ מִבֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ‘e·ḇeḏ- me·leḵ mib·bêṯ ham·me·leḵ way·ḏab·bêr ’el- ham·me·leḵ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Ebed-melech went out from the king’s palace and said to the king . . .
verses.literalPt: Ebede-Meleque saiu da casa do rei, e disse-lhe:

verses.original: אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ הֵרֵ֜עוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְיִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ הִשְׁלִ֖יכוּ אֶל־ הַבּ֑וֹר וַיָּ֤מָת תַּחְתָּיו֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָֽרָעָ֔ב כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין הַלֶּ֛חֶם ע֖וֹד בָּעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ hê·rê·‘ū hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū lə·yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- hiš·lî·ḵū ’el- hab·bō·wr way·yā·māṯ taḥ·tāw mip·pə·nê hā·rā·‘āḇ kî ’ên hal·le·ḥem ‘ō·wḏ bā·‘îr
verses.literal: My lord the king these men have acted wickedly in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet - They have dropped him into the cistern where he will starve to death . . . . . . for there is no more bread in the city
verses.literalPt: Ó rei, senhor meu, estes homens fizeram o mal em tudo quanto fizeram ao profeta Jeremias, a quem lançaram na masmorra. Onde ele está morrerá pela falta de víveres: pois não há mais pão na cidade.

verses.original: וַיְצַוֶּ֣ה הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֛ת עֶֽבֶד־ מֶ֥לֶךְ הַכּוּשִׁ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר קַ֣ח בְּיָדְךָ֤ מִזֶּה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְֽהַעֲלִ֜יתָ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֧הוּ הַנָּבִ֛יא מִן־ הַבּ֖וֹר בְּטֶ֥רֶם יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·weh ham·me·leḵ ’êṯ ‘e·ḇeḏ- me·leḵ hak·kū·šî lê·mōr qaḥ bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā miz·zeh šə·lō·šîm ’ă·nā·šîm wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯā ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî min- hab·bō·wr bə·ṭe·rem yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: So the king commanded Ebed-melech the Cushite . . . Take thirty men from here with you and pull Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies
verses.literalPt: Ordenou o rei a Ebede-Meleque, o etíope, dizendo: Toma daqui contigo trinta homens, e tira da masmorra a Jeremias, o profeta, antes que morra.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח׀ עֶֽבֶד־ מֶ֨לֶךְ אֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּיָד֗וֹ וַיָּבֹ֤א בֵית־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶל־ תַּ֣חַת הָאוֹצָ֔ר וַיִּקַּ֤ח מִשָּׁם֙ בְּלוֹיֵ֣ הַסְּחָבוֹת וּבְלוֹיֵ֖ מְלָחִ֑ים וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֧ם אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל־ הַבּ֖וֹר בַּחֲבָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ‘e·ḇeḏ- me·leḵ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·šîm bə·yā·ḏōw way·yā·ḇō ḇêṯ- ham·me·leḵ ’el- ta·ḥaṯ hā·’ō·w·ṣār way·yiq·qaḥ miš·šām bə·lō·w·yê has·sə·ḥå̄·ḇōṯ ū·ḇə·lō·w·yê mə·lā·ḥîm way·šal·lə·ḥêm ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū ’el- hab·bō·wr ba·ḥă·ḇā·lîm
verses.literal: Then Ebed-melech took the men with him and went to the king’s palace to a place below the storehouse From there he took old rags and worn-out clothes and lowered them with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern
verses.literalPt: Assim Ebede-Meleque tomou consigo os homens, entrou na casa do rei, debaixo da tesouraria, e dali tomou uns velhos panos rotos e uns velhos trapos apodrecidos, e desceu-os com cordas a Jeremias na masmorra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר עֶבֶד־ מֶ֨לֶךְ הַכּוּשִׁ֜י אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ שִׂ֣ים נָ֠א בְּלוֹאֵ֨י הַסְּחָב֤וֹת וְהַמְּלָחִים֙ תַּ֚חַת אַצִּל֣וֹת יָדֶ֔יךָ מִתַּ֖חַת לַחֲבָלִ֑ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ כֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘e·ḇeḏ- me·leḵ hak·kū·šî ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū śîm nā bə·lō·w·’ê has·sə·ḥā·ḇō·wṯ wə·ham·mə·lā·ḥîm ta·ḥaṯ ’aṣ·ṣi·lō·wṯ yā·ḏe·ḵā mit·ta·ḥaṯ la·ḥă·ḇā·lîm way·ya·‘aś yir·mə·yā·hū kên
verses.literal: Ebed-melech the Cushite cried out to Jeremiah Put . . . these worn-out rags and clothes . . . under your arms . . . . . . to pad the ropes Jeremiah did so
verses.literalPt: Ebede-Meleque o etíope disse a Jeremias: Põe agora debaixo dos teus sovacos entre os braços e as cordas estes velhos panos rotos e velhos trapos apodrecidos. Jeremias assim o fez.

verses.original: וַיִּמְשְׁכ֤וּ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ בַּֽחֲבָלִ֔ים וַיַּעֲל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ מִן־ הַבּ֑וֹר וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּחֲצַ֖ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yim·šə·ḵū ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū ba·ḥă·ḇā·lîm way·ya·‘ă·lū ’ō·ṯōw min- hab·bō·wr way·yê·šeḇ yir·mə·yā·hū ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh
verses.literal: and they pulled him up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard
verses.literalPt: Tiraram, pois, a Jeremias com as cordas, e alçaram-no da masmorra; e Jeremias ficou no pátio da guarda.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ אֵלָ֔יו אֶל־ מָבוֹא֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ שֹׁאֵ֨ל אֲנִ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ דָּבָ֔ר אַל־ תְּכַחֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נִּי דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ’ê·lāw ’el- mā·ḇō·w haš·šə·lî·šî ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū šō·’êl ’ă·nî ’ō·ṯə·ḵā dā·ḇār ’al- tə·ḵa·ḥêḏ mim·men·nî dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Then King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah the prophet and received him at the third entrance to the house of the LORD I am going to ask you something said the king to Jeremiah Do not hide anything from me
verses.literalPt: Enviou o rei Zedequias, e fez trazer a si o profeta Jeremias à terceira entrada que está na casa de Jeová; e o rei disse a Jeremias: Vou fazer-te uma pergunta; não me encubras nada.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּ֚י אַגִּ֣יד לְךָ֔ הֲל֖וֹא הָמֵ֣ת תְּמִיתֵ֑נִי וְכִי֙ אִיעָ֣צְךָ֔ לֹ֥א תִשְׁמַ֖ע אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū ’el- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū kî ’ag·gîḏ lə·ḵā hă·lō·w hā·mêṯ tə·mî·ṯê·nî wə·ḵî ’î·‘ā·ṣə·ḵā lō ṯiš·ma‘ ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: If I tell you Jeremiah replied - you will surely put me to death . . . And even if I give you advice you will not listen to me
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeremias a Zedequias: Se eu to anunciar, acaso não me tirarás a vida? Se eu te aconselhar, não me escutarás.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֞ע הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר חַי־ יְהוָ֞ה את אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשָׂה־ לָ֨נוּ אֶת־ הַנֶּ֤פֶשׁ הַזֹּאת֙ אִם־ אֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ וְאִם־ אֶתֶּנְךָ֗ בְּיַד֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְבַקְשִׁ֖ים אֶת־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū bas·sê·ṯer lê·mōr ḥay- Yah·weh ṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh- lā·nū ’eṯ- han·ne·p̄eš haz·zōṯ ’im- ’ă·mî·ṯe·ḵā wə·’im- ’et·ten·ḵā bə·yaḏ hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer mə·ḇaq·šîm ’eṯ- nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: But King Zedekiah swore secretly to Jeremiah As surely as the LORD lives who has given us this life I will not kill you nor will I deliver you into the hands of these men who are seeking your life
verses.literalPt: Jurou secretamente o rei Zedequias a Jeremias, dizendo: Pela vida de Jeová, que nos fez esta alma, não te tirarei a vida nem te entregarei nas mãos destes homens que procuram tirar-te a vida.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ אֶל־ צִדְקִיָּ֡הוּ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־ יָצֹ֨א תֵצֵ֜א אֶל־ שָׂרֵ֤י מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ וְחָיְתָ֣ה נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ וְהָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את לֹ֥א תִשָּׂרֵ֖ף בָּאֵ֑שׁ וְחָיִ֖תָה אַתָּ֥ה וּבֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū ’el- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’im- yā·ṣō ṯê·ṣê ’el- śā·rê me·leḵ- bā·ḇel wə·ḥā·yə·ṯāh nap̄·še·ḵā wə·hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ lō ṯiś·śā·rêp̄ bā·’êš wə·ḥā·yi·ṯāh ’at·tāh ū·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah This is what the LORD God of Hosts the God of Israel says If you indeed surrender . . . to the officers of the king of Babylon then you will live this city will not be burned down . . . and you and your household will survive
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeremias a Zedequias: Assim diz Jeová, Deus dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Se saíres aos príncipes do rei de Babilônia, viverá a tua alma e não será incendiada esta cidade;

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם לֹֽא־ תֵצֵ֗א אֶל־ שָׂרֵי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְנִתְּנָ֞ה הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ בְּיַ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּשְׂרָפ֖וּהָ בָּאֵ֑שׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹֽא־ תִמָּלֵ֥ט מִיָּדָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im lō- ṯê·ṣê ’el- śā·rê me·leḵ bā·ḇel wə·nit·tə·nāh hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm ū·śə·rā·p̄ū·hā bā·’êš wə·’at·tāh lō- ṯim·mā·lêṭ mî·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: But if you do not surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon then this city will be delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans They will burn it down . . . and you yourself will not escape their grasp
verses.literalPt: mas se não saíres aos príncipes do rei de Babilônia, será esta cidade entregue nas mãos dos caldeus, e eles a incendiarão, e tu não escaparás das suas mãos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ אֲנִ֧י דֹאֵ֣ג אֶת־ הַיְּהוּדִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽפְלוּ֙ אֶל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים פֶּֽן־ יִתְּנ֥וּ אֹתִ֛י בְּיָדָ֖ם וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־ בִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū ’ă·nî ḏō·’êḡ ’eṯ- hay·yə·hū·ḏîm ’ă·šer nā·p̄ə·lū ’el- hak·kaś·dîm pen- yit·tə·nū ’ō·ṯî bə·yā·ḏām wə·hiṯ·‘al·lə·lū- ḇî
verses.literal: But King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah I am afraid of the Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans for the Chaldeans may deliver me into their hands to abuse me
verses.literalPt: Disse o rei Zedequias a Jeremias: Receio-me dos judeus que têm passado para os caldeus, não suceda que me entreguem nas mãos deles, e escarneçam de mim.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֹ֣א יִתֵּ֑נוּ שְֽׁמַֽע־ נָ֣א׀ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֗ה לַאֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ דֹּבֵ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיִ֥יטַב לְךָ֖ וּתְחִ֥י נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū lō yit·tê·nū šə·ma‘- nā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh la·’ă·šer ’ă·nî dō·ḇêr ’ê·le·ḵā wə·yî·ṭaḇ lə·ḵā ū·ṯə·ḥî nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: They will not hand you over Jeremiah replied Obey . . . the voice of the LORD in what I am telling you . . . that it may go well with you and you may live
verses.literalPt: Jeremias, porém, disse: Não te entregarão. Obedece à voz de Jeová, naquilo que te falo; assim te irá bem, e viverá a tua alma.

verses.original: וְאִם־ מָאֵ֥ן אַתָּ֖ה לָצֵ֑את זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִרְאַ֖נִי יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- mā·’ên ’at·tāh lā·ṣêṯ zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer hir·’a·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: But if you refuse to surrender this is the word that the LORD has shown me
verses.literalPt: Mas se tu recusares sair, esta é a palavra que me mostrou Jeová.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה כָל־ הַנָּשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁאֲרוּ֙ בְּבֵ֣ית מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה מוּצָא֕וֹת אֶל־ שָׂרֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וְהֵ֣נָּה אֹמְר֗וֹת הִסִּית֜וּךָ וְיָכְל֤וּ לְךָ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י שְׁלֹמֶ֔ךָ הָטְבְּע֥וּ בַבֹּ֛ץ רַגְלֶ֖ךָ נָסֹ֥גוּ אָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ḵāl han·nā·šîm ’ă·šer niš·’ă·rū bə·ḇêṯ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh mū·ṣā·’ō·wṯ ’el- śā·rê me·leḵ bā·ḇel wə·hên·nāh ’ō·mə·rō·wṯ his·sî·ṯū·ḵā wə·yā·ḵə·lū lə·ḵā ’an·šê šə·lō·me·ḵā hā·ṭə·bə·‘ū ḇab·bōṣ raḡ·le·ḵā nā·sō·ḡū ’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: All the women who remain in the palace of the king of Judah will be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon and those women will say They misled you and overcame you those trusted friends of yours Your feet sank into the mire and they deserted you
verses.literalPt: Eis que todas as mulheres que restam na casa do rei de Judá, serão levadas para fora aos príncipes do rei de Babilônia, e dirão: Incitaram-te e prevaleceram contra ti os teus amigos íntimos; agora estão os teus pés atolados no lodo, e esses amigos se apartam de ti.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ נָשֶׁ֣יךָ וְאֶת־ בָּנֶ֗יךָ מֽוֹצִאִים֙ אֶל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹא־ תִמָּלֵ֣ט מִיָּדָ֑ם כִּ֣י בְיַ֤ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ תִּתָּפֵ֔שׂ וְאֶת־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את תִּשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- nā·še·ḵā wə·’eṯ- bā·ne·ḵā mō·w·ṣi·’îm ’el- hak·kaś·dîm wə·’at·tāh lō- ṯim·mā·lêṭ mî·yā·ḏām kî ḇə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel tit·tā·p̄êś wə·’eṯ- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ tiś·rōp̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: All your wives and children will be brought out to the Chaldeans And you yourself will not escape their grasp for you will be seized by the king of Babylon and this city will be burned down . . .
verses.literalPt: Tuas mulheres e teus filhos serão levados para fora aos caldeus, de cujas mãos não escaparás; por mão do rei de Babilônia serás preso; por tua culpa arderá em fogo esta cidade.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אִ֛ישׁ אַל־ יֵדַ֥ע בַּדְּבָֽרִים־ הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְלֹ֥א תָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū ’îš ’al- yê·ḏa‘ bad·də·ḇā·rîm- hā·’êl·leh wə·lō ṯā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Then Zedekiah . . . warned Jeremiah Do not let anyone know about this conversation or you will die
verses.literalPt: Disse Zedequias a Jeremias: Não saiba ninguém estas palavras, e não morrerás.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִשְׁמְע֣וּ הַשָּׂרִים֮ כִּֽי־ דִבַּ֣רְתִּי אִתָּךְ֒ וּבָ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֣יךָ וְֽאָמְר֪וּ אֵלֶ֟יךָ הַגִּֽידָה־ נָּ֨א לָ֜נוּ מַה־ דִּבַּ֧רְתָּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אַל־ תְּכַחֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וְלֹ֣א נְמִיתֶ֑ךָ וּמַה־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yiš·mə·‘ū haś·śā·rîm kî- ḏib·bar·tî ’it·tāḵ ū·ḇā·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’ā·mə·rū ’ê·le·ḵā hag·gî·ḏāh- nā lā·nū mah- dib·bar·tā ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’al- tə·ḵa·ḥêḏ mim·men·nū wə·lō nə·mî·ṯe·ḵā ū·mah- dib·ber ’ê·le·ḵā ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: If the officials hear that I have spoken with you and they come and demand of you Tell . . . us what you said to the king and what he said to you do not hide it from us or we will kill you
verses.literalPt: Mas se os príncipes ouvirem que falei contigo, e vierem a ti e te disserem: Declara-nos agora o que disseste ao rei; não no-lo encubras, e não te mataremos; declara-nos também o que o rei te disse a ti:

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מַפִּיל־ אֲנִ֥י תְחִנָּתִ֖י לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ לְבִלְתִּ֧י הֲשִׁיבֵ֛נִי בֵּ֥ית יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן לָמ֥וּת שָֽׁם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem map·pîl- ’ă·nî ṯə·ḥin·nā·ṯî lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ lə·ḇil·tî hă·šî·ḇê·nî bêṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān lā·mūṯ šām
verses.literal: then tell them . . . I was presenting to the king my petition that he not return me to the house of Jonathan to die there
verses.literalPt: dir-lhes-ás: Apresentei a minha súplica diante do rei, que não me fizesse voltar à casa de Jônatas para ali morrer.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ כָל־ הַשָּׂרִ֤ים אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ וַיִּשְׁאֲל֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וַיַּגֵּ֤ד לָהֶם֙ כְּכָל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיַּחֲרִ֣שׁוּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹֽא־ נִשְׁמַ֖ע הַדָּבָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḵāl haś·śā·rîm ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū way·yiš·’ă·lū ’ō·ṯōw way·yag·gêḏ lā·hem kə·ḵāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ham·me·leḵ way·ya·ḥă·ri·šū mim·men·nū kî lō- niš·ma‘ had·dā·ḇār
verses.literal: When all the officials came to Jeremiah and questioned him he relayed to them the exact words . . . the king had commanded him to say So they said no more to him for no one had overheard the conversation
verses.literalPt: Vieram todos os príncipes a Jeremias e lhe perguntaram; e ele lhes respondeu segundo todas estas palavras que o rei ordenara. Assim cessaram de falar com ele; porque a coisa não foi percebida.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֔ה עַד־ י֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ נִלְכְּדָ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑םס וְהָיָ֕ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִלְכְּדָ֖ה יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ yir·mə·yā·hū ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh ‘aḏ- yō·wm ’ă·šer- nil·kə·ḏāh yə·rū·šå̄·lå̄·ms wə·hā·yāh ka·’ă·šer nil·kə·ḏāh yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard until the day Jerusalem was captured - . . .
verses.literalPt: Então ficou Jeremias no pátio da guarda, até o dia em que foi tomada Jerusalém.
